reason: planning stopped before any code was written: the plan still needed revising in the last round (round 3 of 3). Read: gh.rs (Remote/GitRemote, land_pr at 1287, replace_head, publish, Athena::land_pr with the resync call at 1630), pr.rs (PrLink, check_push, check_replace), athena-git replay, and the grep results for resync_onto_merge and resync_tip. The plan fixes the fault where it starts: it removes the post-merge resync_onto_merge call, and land.rs is the only other place that refers to the resync. It also covers the side effect of removing it, PR diffs that grow with each landed job, by cutting the pushed head with the existing Git::replay, and it adds a sidecar so reruns do not push again. The named functions exist: resync_onto_merge, resync_tip, replay, is_ancestor, signs_commits, PrHost: Host and replace_head. The work fits one producer run. One gap is major. The cut lives only in GitRemote::cut_head, whose trait default is Ok(None), but every test goes through a FakeRemote. The criterion 2 diff assertion and the cut tests will therefore either fail or test the double's own logic instead of the production cut. The cut logic should be shared, or the tests should use GitRemote over a local bare repo. The smaller findings: say what replay range the cut uses, record that check_replace already allows non-fast-forward replacement under the expected-head check, and document that a tip moved by outside commits is refused by the new fingerprint check. Findings: major: With the cut on a trait method that defaults to Ok(None), tests through FakeRemote never run GitRemote::cut_head. So the cut, the B-PR-diff assertion and the cut/fingerprint-refusal tests either fail or pass on logic written in the test double. (Plan decision 5 and step 7 / Demonstrations for criteria 2 and 3; gh.rs:559-602 (Remote, GitRemote)); minor: The replay range (`from`) is not specified. (Plan step 2 (GitRemote::cut_head calls replay); athena-git/src/lib.rs:701); minor: The open question about non-fast-forward replacement is already answered by the code. The plan should state it, and the producer must not tighten check_replace. (Plan decision 6 / Risks (replace_head non-fast-forward); pr.rs:170-192); minor: The new rule that the cut tree must match the verified fingerprint means a cut onto a tip moved by commits other than Athena's squashes is always refused. The docs should say this is how a stale job is handled. (Plan decision 6 and the docs for criterion 6); nit: Several values attempt() uses (config, content, title/body, verification, the head and branch) are computed before the client is built. The plan does not say they move into land_pr_with. (Plan step 5 (land_pr_with parameter list))
